one_liner: Front is a customer service platform powered by AI with shared inboxes and collaborative support tools.

auth.notes: API tokens and OAuth2 both supported. OAuth uses authorization code grant type only. Basic auth used only during OAuth token exchange.

evidence.snippet: OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets external applications request authorization to API access in a secure way.
Front supports OAuth2.0 as well as API Tokens.
Front's OAuth implementation only supports the authorization code grant type

access.notes: Free developer account provides sandbox environment with full API access. No credit card, approval, or sales contact required. Developer accounts limited to 3 teammates.

evidence.snippet: You can create a developer account by signing up here . You’ll get access to a free developer environment
The developer account will provide you with an environment that does not include production data so it will be safer to test in.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 50 rpm (Starter), 200 rpm (Professional). Professional plan required for increases. Additional capacity: $200 per 100 rpm/month.

evidence.snippet: The API is designed to communicate with your server using JSON.
Our webhooks also make it possible to respond to real-time events as actions and updates happen in Front.
By default, Front's API rate limit starts at 50 requests per minute and varies depending on your plan
Rate limit increases beyond the default limits require the Professional plan or higher.
Access Front data and actions through the MCP protocol, allowing AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to read and reply to conversations and other Front resources.

buildability.rationale: Free developer account provides immediate API access without approval; REST API with webhooks well-documented; 180-tool toolkit already exists in Composio.

Our primary backend API that allows you to read, create, update, and delete a wide range of data across Front's various entities
